criteria.criterion: amendment-discharge: task-3 discharges findings 5a2a64b6 (S2, silent probe skips) and e17913e2 (S3, filter doc comment lacks (i)-(iii))
criteria.evidence: 5a2a64b6 — fired-branch shape at TrustedApplicationGateTests.swift:144-150: 'guard localSigningIdentityPresent() else { print("probe skipped: signing identity absent"); withKnownIssue("probe skipped: signing identity absent") { Issue.record("probe skipped: signing identity absent") }; return }'. Why a fired skip is now recorded rather than silent, read from the pinned swift-testing 0.12.0 checkout: KnownIssue.swift:115-120 withKnownIssue(_ comment:, isIntermittent: false, ...) delegates with matching: { _ in true }; :180-191 runs the body under Issue.$currentKnownIssueMatcher so the body's Issue.record is matched and recorded as a KNOWN issue (counted by matchCounter); the defer at :182-186 calls _handleMiscount only when isIntermittent is false, and _handleMiscount (:66-75) records a secondary .knownIssueNotRecorded issue only if matchCounter == 0 — the body records exactly once, so no secondary issue. Event.HumanReadableOutputRecorder.swift:140-142 prints ' with N known issue(s)' on the test's pass line, so a CI run that takes the branch reads 'passed ... with 1 known issue' instead of a bare pass, while a non-firing run (this host: identity PRESENT, 0 'known issue' lines in both logs) records nothing. All four sites (:146,:210,:338,:478) use the same shape. e17913e2 — the (i)-(iii) lines are TrustedApplicationGate.swift:205-212 (quoted in full under task-3 C3). They describe the sink code as it is: LiveCredentialWriter.swift:133-134 '// (i) An empty filtered list (trustedPaths: []) writes WITHOUT / kSecAttrAccess ...', :138 'if !filteredPaths.isEmpty {', :140-149 'guard !trustedApps.isEmpty else { // (ii) ... return false }', :151-152 '// (iii) SecAccessCreate only ever runs with a non-empty array.' / 'SecAccessCreate(service as CFString, trustedApps as CFArray, &access)'; AccountCredentialVault.swift:208 '(i)', :212-221 '(ii)' guard, :223-224 '(iii)' then SecAccessCreate; both files named in the comment without line numbers. Nothing in the 24-line diff was flagged by grader, reviewer (bounded, [] at its turn cap) or tester; I read all four hunks and the doc block myself and found no defect.
